subject: general
question:
Pradeep, Nikku, Rinku, Sohail and Tannu are sitting on a bench facing north. Pradeep is immediate neighbour of Nikku, Sohail is immediate neighbour of Tannu, Pradeep is not sitting with Rinku who sits on the right end of the bench. Pradeep sits to the right of Sohail and Tannu. Sohail sits to the right of Tannu.

In which position Pradeep is sitting?
solution:
**Given : **Pradeep, Nikku, Rinku, Sohail and Tannu are sitting on a bench facing north.

**Explanation : **

1) Pradeep is not sitting with Rinku who sits on the right end of the bench.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b993ea6f87dbb1fb48491fea66381268096b58863eb973bc39ee097b8094cf12.png] 

2) Sohail is immediate neighbour of Tannu.

3) Sohail sits to the right of Tannu
